name: App Shell UI
description: UI interaction spec for the root application orchestrator. Coordinates workspace lifecycle through modal flows and delegates UI creation to CanvasArea and TopBar.

modals.name: Welcome Modal
modals.trigger: No CLI workspace path on startup
modals.flow: modal.open() → resolve(path | null) → loadWorkspace() or window.close()

modals.name: About Modal
modals.flow: about.open(onClose) → locks canvas → onClose unlocks canvas

interactions.action: Save current state → IPC workspace:select → loadWorkspace()

states.loading: Title set to 'Cockpit IDE', theme preference loaded, workspace prompt initiated
states.no_workspace: WelcomeModal shown, no canvas state loaded
states.workspace_loaded: Canvas populated with restored/auto-arranged plugins, file watcher active, auto-save enabled
states.empty_workspace: New workspace: addExplorer + addTerminal + autoArrange + centerView
